The call ends without a locked appointment — only a vague plan to text the bill and 'schedule' later, with the customer's preferred callback window captured almost as an afterthought.
outcome_dispute: V1 tag is unknown/unclear; the observed transcript supports 'callback' at best, not 'booked' — no day or time was set for an appointment, only a promise to follow up once the customer sends a bill photo or email.

observed_outcome.reasoning: No day or time was locked for an appointment; the rep's plan is to text the customer, wait for a bill photo/email once the customer returns home, and schedule at that later point.
